description: A /*! license */ block, an ordinary comment and a sourceMappingURL comment: critical keeps all three comments.

thin.note: The new layer never reads or writes a source map (postcss runs with map: false, so no local file is ever looked up), and postcss then deletes the sourceMappingURL comment from the css; the license block and the ordinary comment stay. expected-thin.css is critical's own output for the same sheet without that comment (the comment is the last line of the sheet, so nothing else moves).
